name: Lo'sho Amplification gates Starfire Shot's Lunar Eclipse trigger/consume (#5815)
contract: Issue 5815 (level 14 Starcaller): Starfire Shot 801978 'doesn't consume nor trigger the Lunar Eclipse
effect'. AscensionStarcaller.cpp's Lunar(info, player) only matches 801978 when the caster also has aura
500205 (Lo'sho Amplification), the same pattern already shipped for 680220/92134 (Huntress Shot/Moon
Priest): 500205's tooltip reads 'Your Starfire Shot now has a Lunar Eclipse effect', mirroring 92134's
'Your Huntress Shot now has a Lunar Eclipse effect'. When Lunar() matches,
AscensionStarcallerAbilities.cpp's Snapshot() tags both the Lunar Eclipse aura 800386 and the Starfire
Shot cast with a shared generation; OnSpellHitResult then casts the Burn DoT 561122 (Named(info,801978)
&& spell->GetScriptValue(800386) && player->HasAura(500205)), and FinishSelected removes aura 800386 for
a matching generation on any non-triggered cast. Without 500205 none of this is tagged, so Lunar Eclipse
is neither triggered (no 561122) nor consumed (800386 stays), exactly the reported symptom. This
scenario pins both outcomes: a control fixture without 500205 keeps Lunar Eclipse and gets no Burn DoT
after casting Starfire Shot, while an otherwise identical fixture with 500205 loses Lunar Eclipse and
gets the Burn DoT. Starfire Shot requires an equipped ranged weapon (EquippedItemClass 2,
EquippedItemSubClassMask 262156, matching 680220, satisfied here with the same Worn Shortbow 2504 the
shipped Huntress Shot scenario uses) and a target that already carries Scattered Star 804378
(TargetAuraSpell), so both fixtures first cast Fan of Knives 680703 (no weapon requirement) on their own
dummy to apply one stack. Both fixtures reach 4 Lunar Phase stacks (802985) plus the threshold marker
704519 by fixture aura, then cast Lunar Eclipse 800386 on themselves, exactly as the shipped
lunar-eclipse-consumption.json regression does. The setup Fan of Knives 680703 is an authored Melee
attack, so both matching fixtures explicitly configure and assert native melee hit and expertise before
requiring a real hit and Scattered Star. The original Lunar Eclipse learned/unlearned controls and Burn
observations remain unchanged.
